# CacheWithOptions interface

Options for the [cacheWith()](/api/pg-cache/latest/pg-cache.cachewith/) method decorator: which tables invalidate the cached result, how long it may live, and the tag it is stored under.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface CacheWithOptions 
```
